caseName: Nantahala Power & Light Co. v. Thornburg
caseNameFull: Nantahala Power & Light Co. v. Thornburg, Attorney General of North Carolina

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. N. C. Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of Nantahala Power & Light Co. v. Thornburg, 476 U. S. 953 (1986).

Justice Powell and Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
